## What it will cover

::: {.mm-stub-outline}
- Why generate molecules, and how to judge generated sets (validity, uniqueness, novelty)
- Variational autoencoders on fingerprints and SMILES
- Character-level language models for SMILES and SELFIES
- Diffusion and flow models in outline
- Sampling, temperature and mode collapse
- Lab 13: train a small SMILES language model and sample new molecules
:::

## Planned learning outcomes

1. Train a generative model of molecules and sample from it.
2. Evaluate generated molecules with validity, uniqueness, novelty and property distributions.
3. Explain the trade-offs between representations (SMILES, SELFIES, graphs) for generation.
